verdict.rationale: Runloop offers a CLI (rli) and SDKs for scripting devbox lifecycle, an official GitHub Action (deploy-agent) for CI-driven agent deployment, a benchmarks CLI that provisions devboxes and runs agents/scoring end-to-end, and headless execution primitives (execute-commands, named shells, PTY, logs) suitable for automation pipelines. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report of a full CI pipeline in production, and no explicit 'headless mode' framing beyond CLI/API/GitHub Action usage.
